confirmed.title: Weave Confirmed
confirmed.content: {actorName} confirmed the weave for "{postTitle}". Waiting for your confirmation.

DISPATCH_FAILED.title: Delivery booking failed — full refund on the way
DISPATCH_FAILED.content: We're sorry, we couldn't book a Lalamove driver for order {tradeNo}. Your payment of NT${amount} will be refunded in full to your card. We'll let you know once it's done.

PAID_AFTER_ORDER_CLOSED.title: Order expired before payment — full refund on the way
PAID_AFTER_ORDER_CLOSED.content: Your payment for order {tradeNo} arrived after the delivery order had expired, so no driver was booked. NT${amount} will be refunded in full to your card. Please book the delivery again.

REFUNDED.title: Delivery payment refunded
REFUNDED.content: {reason, select, LALAMOVE_EXPIRED {No driver accepted your delivery in time, so your} LALAMOVE_REJECTED {Lalamove could not fulfil your delivery, so your} PAID_AFTER_ORDER_CLOSED {Your payment arrived after the delivery order expired, so your} other {Your}} payment of NT${amount} for order {tradeNo} has been refunded to your card. The exact posting date depends on your card issuer.

REFUND_FAILED.title: Your refund is being processed
REFUND_FAILED.content: We couldn't complete the refund of NT${amount} for order {tradeNo} automatically. Our support team has been notified and will contact you shortly.
